Class Siren

java.lang.Object
Character_Classes.GameCharacter
Character_Classes.EnemyChar
Character_Classes.Siren
public class Siren extends EnemyChar
Represents the Siren boss enemy encountered on the BossFloor. The Siren remains dormant until released, at which point it pursues and attacks the nearer of the two playable characters, and can summon Bat reinforcements scaled to the current difficulty tier.

      public Siren(int x, int y)
      Constructs a Siren boss enemy at the given grid position with fixed combat stats (10.0 attack, 750 gold drop, 1 turn per move, detection range of 100, diagonal movement enabled) and a starting health of 1.0. The Siren begins in a dormant, unreleased state.
      Parameters:
      x - the starting X grid coordinate
      y - the starting Y grid coordinate

      public void move(PlayableChar Yohane, PlayableChar Lailaps)
      Manages the Siren's turn execution while released: attacks whichever playable character is adjacent, or otherwise moves one tile toward the nearer of the two playable characters. Takes no action while dormant.
      Parameters:
      Yohane - the first playable character reference
      Lailaps - the second playable character reference
